title: Damage/Gas Damage
summary: Gas damage and AoE toxin-cloud status.
extract:
Gas Damage is one of the six secondary elemental damage types, composed of  Heat and  Toxin elements. Deals increased damage to Infested Deimos and Techrot enemies but reduced damage against Scaldra enemies. Its Status Effect creates a damaging cloud that deals  Gas Damage over Time.

Status Effects

General
The status effect of  Gas damage is Gas Cloud. It produces a gas cloud that deals a tick of damage each second to all enemies within a 3-meter radius; subsequent procs increase the radius by 0.3 meters up to 6 meters in total after 10 stacks. The cloud has a 6 second duration. Each tick deals  Gas damage equal to:

Gas Proc Damage per Tick=0.5×Modded Base Damage×(1+Gas Damage Bonuses)×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)×(1+Status Damage Bonuses)×Additional Multipliers
Gas Damage Bonuses include  Valence Formation.
Additional Multipliers include modded critical multiplier on Critical Hit and multipliers on Enemy Body Parts; these stack multiplicatively with each other.
Modded Base Damage is not the same as normal damage calculations, ignoring physical and elemental damage bonuses and calculated as:
Modded Base Damage=Base Damage×(1+Base Damage Bonuses)×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)
As can be seen from the formula, tick damage scales with  Gas mods ( Heat and  Toxin mods have no effect). Up to 10 instances of the effect can stack on the same target, with each instance having its own timer. Any instances after the 10th will replace the oldest instance.
The Gas Cloud is able to hit heads and other body parts by itself. However, the Gas Cloud itself has a 1x damage bonus when headshotting. This can be increased with the use of mods such as  Target Acquired, zoom bonuses on some sniper rifles, or  Primary Deadhead/ Secondary Deadhead.
Example 1 ( Heat and  Toxin mods), tick damage for a weapon with an innate 180 damage,  Hornet Strike,   Scorch,  Pathogen Rounds,  Expel Grineer, and  Pistol Elementalist will be:

Modded Base Damage = 180 × (1 + 2.2) × (1 + 0.3) = 748.8
Tick Damage = 0.5 × 748.8 × (1 + 0.3) × (1 + 0.9) = 924.768
Example 2 ( Gas mod), tick damage for the  Vesper 77 with  Hornet Strike,  Leaded Gas,  Expel Grineer, and  Pistol Elementalist will be:

Modded Base Damage = 180 × (1 + 2.2) × (1 + 0.3) = 748.8
Tick Damage = 0.5 × 748.8 × (1 + 3) × (1 + 0.3) × (1 + 0.9) = 3,699.072
As can be seen in the above calculations for tick damage, Faction Damage is applied twice, making their effective bonus = (1 + Faction Damage bonus)2. Which is +69% for the 30% Faction Damage mods and +140.25% for the 55% Primed Faction Damage mods.
If the host target dies,  Gas will continue to tick damage on all enemies caught in the host's radius for its remaining duration.
A  Gas proc briefly creates a dark green cloud on the afflicted.

Railjack
 Gas does not have a Railjack space counterpart and is thus not able to proc any status effect nor is it included in calculations for status proc weighting.

Trivia
Gas damage, with its brown color, damage over time, and its extra lethality to Deimos  Infested, is likely a reference or callback to Enferon, a gas that is highly lethal to creatures infected by the Technocyte Virus but not uninfected humans in Digital Extremes' earlier title, Dark Sector.
This is further expanded with the weakness  Techrot possess, as well as the existence of Efervon, a very similarly named substance used by  Scaldra against the Techrot. Scaldra are also resistant to Gas damage.
